scripts.test: sh -c 'rm -rf .test-dist; tsc --ignoreConfig src/routes.ts src/app-state.ts src/render-lifecycle.ts src/host-environment.ts --outDir .test-dist --module ESNext --target ES2022 --moduleResolution Bundler --skipLibCheck; status=$?; if [ $status -eq 0 ]; then node --test test/routes.test.mjs test/render-lifecycle.test.mjs test/host-environment.test.mjs; status=$?; fi; rm -rf .test-dist; exit $status'
scripts.build: npm run test && npm run typecheck && vite build
